plotHookRolled: hook.grief_absorption, hook.death_and_return, hook.trial_by_combat
plotHookTaken:  hook.death_and_return - the miller's boy was laid out for dead at harvest and woke under
the healer's hands; the lane says what woke is not the boy. The truth is spoiled rye: the
fits and burning hands are the sickness in the bread, and the boy is the boy.
Seed dice: p3 unmitigated_risk (the pyre is built) - opposition terrain (indifference), read as the
sickness in the rye, which cares nothing for whom the town blames - agentRole client_who_is_owed,
realised as the favour the magistrate may come to owe (a reaction), never asserted as history
(prose rule 7) - scale settlement - system traits (advisory: two trait variants).
--- The narrator's 12 questions, answered ---
1 P1 arrival?      Yes: {actor} arrives in {location}, sent for by the magistrate. Graph names.
2 P2 events?       A healer is in the stocks; a pyre is built; the boy was laid out for dead and woke;
he has fits and burning hands since.
3 P3 one stake?    Unmitigated risk (rolled): say whether the healer is touched before the pyre is lit.
4 <=80 words?      75 / 80 (opening + step-0 spine).
5 Read aloud?      Report throughout; no interior sensation.
6 Stated?          "The lane says what woke is not the boy." States the town's belief plainly.
7 Every sentence works? Challenge, test or outcome.
8 Nothing unintroduced? Stocks, pyre, miller, boy, healer, magistrate in the step-0 spine; the mill house,
the loft and the household in step 1's spine; the square and the crowd in step 2's.
9 One named person? {cast:accused} in step 0, nobody named in step 1, {cast:magistrate} in step 2.
10 Stake in a sentence? Can {actor} say whether the healer is touched, and what made the boy
sick, before the town lights the pyre?
11 Cards verb+noun? Settle Frightened Breath, Uncover True Spirit, Remember Wet Harvest, Quicken Hidden Rot,
Silence Angry Square, Wake Old Gratitude.
12 Opening per class? urban, written.
--- Mechanical design block ---
Crux            A healer is in the stocks for witchcraft and the pyre is built; the boy's sickness is in the rye.
Shape           Query prize on a three-step read -> read -> rule spine. veil 0.74 (continue_weakened)
-> veil 0.80 (continue_weakened) -> veil 0.84 (fail_action). Linear, branch count 0.
Consequence hand (binding): relationship (bond_change $cast:accused +0.12 on step 2 success; bond_change
$cast:magistrate -0.12 on step 2 failure, -0.04 on step 0 and step 1 failure) + secret
(hidden_mark secret_knowledge on $actor, step 2 success: the miller knew the rye was spoiled;
favor_creation, debtor $cast:magistrate, on the 'leave the miller to the magistrate'
reaction). No swap.
Query prize     Step 2 rewardPool { possession: 1 } tagFilters [#healing, #provision]: a remedy (poultice, incense, cup) from the healer's
house, given in thanks.
Standing        reputation_with $here +0.05 / -0.06 on step 2; -0.02 on step 0 and step 1 failure (backs
the critical_failure chips on every route: a critical failure at any step ends the action).
Cost channels   All specials essence-priced. No Heavy Hand, no rider, no Undertow.
Cool failure    The mortal is not killed, jailed or branded. Failure: the healer is held in chains and
the magistrate is left unsettled. Critical failure: the crowd burns the house; chains. No assize
or later trial is promised (rule 34): the engine performs none. Stated plainly in the overviews.
Gender          The accused and the magistrate are bound cast (reuse-first), so prose never genders
either: 'the healer', 'the magistrate', or the token.
Accepted limit  No band-keyed step write: critical_success and success_at_cost differ from success by
prose. The miller's anger on success_at_cost is told, unchipped.
Not colliding   Veil master: lay an ossuary's dead. Veil experts: hear a drowned man, judge an
oath-breaker. This one reads a living accused and a sick house; no card questions the dead.

stakes.goal: clear the accused healer before the pyre is lit
stakes.risk: see the healer's house burned and the healer chained

template.name: The Witch Trial

openings.urban: {actor} arrives in {location}, sent for by the magistrate.

steps.narrativeTemplate:
A healer is in the stocks for witchcraft, and a pyre stands built in the square. At harvest the miller's boy was laid out for dead and woke under the healer's hands. He has had fits since, and his hands burn. The lane says what woke is not the boy.

The magistrate asks {actor} to say whether {cast:accused} is touched, before the town lights the pyre.
steps.criticalSuccessAfterimage: By noon {actor} was sure. No mark of the unseen was on {cast:accused}, and the healer named the day the boy first ate the new bread.
steps.successAfterimage: No mark of the unseen was on {cast:accused}. The healer was frightened and tired, and told the same account of the boy's waking each time.
steps.successAtCostAfterimage: No mark of the unseen was on {cast:accused}, but the crowd watched {actor} sit at the stocks all morning and began to say the master was bewitched too.
steps.failureAfterimage: They could not tell. {cast:accused} was too frightened to answer plainly, and {actor} left the stocks without a reading.
steps.criticalFailureAfterimage: {cast:accused} would not speak to them at all. The magistrate called off the reading, and the crowd took that for an answer.

nudges.name: Settle Frightened Breath
nudges.effectLine: Slow the prisoner's racing heart, so the answers given in the stocks come steady and plain.

bandProse.critical_success: {cast:accused} stopped shaking and answered every question in a level voice.
bandProse.success: The healer's breathing slowed, and the answers came plain.
bandProse.near_miss: The healer grew calm only by noon, after a morning too frightened to answer.
bandProse.failure: The healer grew calm enough to talk, and talked only of the pyre.

nudges.name: Uncover True Spirit
nudges.effectLine: Bring any mark of the unseen on the prisoner into plain view, if a mark is there.

bandProse.success: No mark of the unseen showed on {cast:accused}, and {actor} could say so plainly.
bandProse.success_at_cost: No mark showed, but the crowd watched {actor} lay hands on the healer and muttered about it.
bandProse.failure: A faint mark showed on the healer, left by years of setting bones with old charms.
bandProse.critical_failure: The crowd saw a light pass over the healer's face and shouted that the witch was proven.

steps.narrativeTemplate: The harm began at the mill house, where the boy lies. The miller keeps the door and wants the healer burned. The household says the boy was cold for a night and a day before he woke. Their grain is stored in the loft above. The sickness in the house does not care what the town believes, and it will show its cause only to a careful reading.
steps.criticalSuccessAfterimage: They found the cause before dark. The rye in the mill loft came in black from the low field, and the household has eaten bread from it since harvest.
steps.successAfterimage: They found black, spoiled rye in the mill loft. The household has eaten bread from it since harvest.
steps.successAtCostAfterimage: They found the spoiled rye in the loft, but the miller caught them at the sacks and threw them out of the house.
steps.failureAfterimage: They read the house until dark and found no cause they could name. They will have to rule without one.
steps.criticalFailureAfterimage: The boy had a fit while they were in the room, and the miller ran into the street shouting that the witch's friend had brought it on. The magistrate called the reading off.

critical_success.text: They are sure the healer is not touched.

success.text: They found no mark of the unseen on the healer.

success_at_cost.text: The crowd says they are bewitched too.

near_miss.text: They read the healer only after a long morning.

failure.text: They could not tell whether the healer is touched.

nudges.name: Remember Wet Harvest
nudges.effectLine: Bring back to the household the rainy weeks at reaping, so they can say which field each sack of grain came from.

bandProse.critical_success: The household remembered at once which sacks came from the low field, and went straight to them.
bandProse.success: The household remembered the rainy reaping, and the sacks from the low field.
bandProse.near_miss: The household remembered the low field only at dusk, after a day of wrong answers.
bandProse.failure: The household remembered the rain, and blamed the healer for it.

nudges.name: Quicken Hidden Rot
nudges.effectLine: Hasten the decay already in the stored grain, so the spoiled sacks turn black where anyone can see.

bandProse.success: The spoiled sacks in the loft turned black overnight, and the rest stayed clean.
bandProse.success_at_cost: The spoiled sacks turned black, and the miller saw them first and swore they had been cursed.
bandProse.failure: The decay spread to the good sacks too, and the whole loft looked cursed.
bandProse.critical_failure: The whole loft went black in a night, and the lane said the healer had cursed the mill.

steps.narrativeTemplate: {cast:magistrate} hears the ruling in the square at noon, with the crowd around the pyre. {actor} must say whether the healer is touched, and what made the boy sick. If the ruling names the wrong cause, the boy will still have fits, and the town will still want a witch.
steps.criticalSuccessAfterimage: {cast:magistrate} tasted the black rye in front of the square and spat it out. The crowd let the healer out of the stocks and pulled down the pyre. A mill hand told {actor} the miller had known the rye was bad.
steps.successAfterimage: {cast:magistrate} ruled that the healer was not touched and that the rye made the boy sick. Afterwards a mill hand told {actor} the miller knew the rye was bad and ground it anyway.
steps.successAtCostAfterimage: {cast:magistrate} freed the healer on the ruling, but the miller swore before the whole square that {actor} had lied to save a witch. A mill hand told {actor} the miller had known the rye was bad.
steps.failureAfterimage: The crowd would not hear the ruling. {cast:magistrate} would not burn the healer on {actor}'s doubt, and would not free the healer either.
steps.criticalFailureAfterimage: The ruling fell apart in front of the square, and the crowd stopped listening. {cast:magistrate} held the pyre, and could not hold the crowd.

critical_success.text: They know the spoiled rye made the boy sick.

success.text: They found the spoiled rye in the mill loft.

success_at_cost.text: The miller threw them out of the mill house.

near_miss.text: They found the spoiled rye only at dusk.

failure.text: They do not know what made the boy sick.

effects.label: the miller ground the spoiled rye knowing it was bad, then named the healer

nudges.name: Silence Angry Square
nudges.effectLine: Quiet the shouting around the pyre, so the ruling is heard to its last word.

bandProse.critical_success: The crowd went quiet, and the ruling was heard to the end.
bandProse.success: The shouting died down long enough for the ruling to be heard.
bandProse.near_miss: The crowd quieted only after the ruling had been read twice.
bandProse.failure: The crowd went quiet, and in the quiet the miller called the ruling a lie.
bandProse.critical_failure: The crowd went silent, then broke into shouting all at once.

nudges.name: Wake Old Gratitude
nudges.effectLine: Bring back to the crowd every fever and broken bone the healer once tended, so each weighs on them as the ruling is read.

bandProse.success: Faces in the crowd remembered fevers the healer had nursed, and turned away from the pyre.
bandProse.success_at_cost: The crowd remembered the healer's help, and the miller shouted that a witch would be helpful.
bandProse.failure: The crowd remembered the healer's help, and the children the healer could not save.
bandProse.critical_failure: The crowd remembered every patient the healer had lost, and called each name aloud.

traitVariants.factorLine: Being Warm, they can get a frightened healer to talk.
Being Proud, they want a ruling the crowd will cheer.

narrativeTemplates.initiation: A healer is in a town's stocks for witchcraft, and the magistrate sends for a master to say whether the healer is touched.
narrativeTemplates.success: The healer was cleared, and the pyre came down.
narrativeTemplates.failure: The healer was not cleared, and the town still wants a witch.

fallback.overview: {actor} has given the magistrate a ruling, and {location} waits to see what it does with the healer.

reactions.label: Name the miller in the square
reactions.intent: The mortal tells the whole square what the miller did. The town is grateful; the magistrate wanted it kept quiet.

reactions.label: Leave the miller to the magistrate
reactions.intent: The mortal tells only the magistrate, and keeps the miller's part out of the square. The magistrate owes them for the quiet.

effects.context: Kept the miller's spoiled rye out of the square

critical_success.overview: {cast:accused} is cleared, and the whole lane saw it done. The healer presses a remedy from the house into {actor}'s hands in thanks.

changes.title: The Miller's Rye
changes.detail: {actor} knows the miller ground the rye knowing it was spoiled.

success.overview: {cast:accused} is out of the stocks, and the pyre comes down. The healer gives {actor} a remedy from the house in thanks.

changes.title: The Miller's Rye
changes.detail: {actor} knows the miller ground the rye knowing it was spoiled.

success_at_cost.overview: {cast:accused} is out of the stocks and gives {actor} a remedy from the house in thanks. The miller is still calling {actor} a liar to anyone who will listen.

changes.title: The Miller's Rye
changes.detail: {actor} knows the miller ground the rye knowing it was spoiled.

failure.overview: The healer is alive and held in chains, and the pyre still stands in the square. The magistrate sent for a master to settle this, and it is not settled.

reactions.label: Sit with the healer in chains
reactions.intent: The mortal sits by the healer through the night, where the town can see. The healer will remember it, and the town will too.

reactions.label: Stay clear of the healer
reactions.intent: The mortal keeps away from the healer that night, so the crowd has no reason to turn on them too. The healer sees who did not come.

critical_failure.overview: The crowd burned the healer's house and every remedy in it, and the healer is held in chains. A master was sent for to stop this, and it happened anyway.

reactions.label: Sit with the healer in chains
reactions.intent: The mortal sits by the healer through the night, where the town can see. The healer will remember it, and the town will too.

reactions.label: Stay clear of the healer
reactions.intent: The mortal keeps away from the healer that night, so the crowd has no reason to turn on them too. The healer sees who did not come.

template.description: A healer sits in a town's stocks for witchcraft, with a pyre built in the square. Someone has to say, before the magistrate and the crowd, whether the healer is touched and what made the miller's boy sick.
